_note: Pre-trade asset-class dispatch (Workstream P-1, AUR-PRETRADE-REG-001). Ahead of the Thifur-J gate set, this fixture selects the applicable gate plan by instrument asset class. The base 8 gates apply to every class; a class may DECLARE additional gates. A gate with status 'active' runs its callable; a gate with status 'declared' is NOT yet implemented and routes to HOLD (fail-safe, never a silent pass) — the pre-trade rendering of the gap-completeness invariant. Equities and any unmapped class get exactly the base 8 gates (zero behavior change from pre-P-1). Editing this fixture is a doctrine event. Asset-class-specific gate implementations (e.g. TOKENIZED_ELIGIBILITY) are Workstream P-3. Fixed-income clearing/settlement gating is Atreides' domain, not Aureon pre-trade — see AUR-PRETRADE-REG-001 §VI.
